title: miRBioGenAtlas: Sample-level multi-modal somatic alteration landscape of the miRNA biogenesis machinery across 32 TCGA cancer studies
description: Versioned, SHA-256-verified sample-level, variant-level, saturation-mutagenesis, mature miRNA-seq, proteogenomic, CRISPR-dependency, germline-constraint, and clinical-replication resource covering 15 canonical microRNA biogenesis and regulatory genes across 32 TCGA PanCancer Atlas (2018) studies (33 cancer types; N = 10,195 primary tumours; 152,925 sample x gene records) plus an independent MSK-IMPACT clinical cohort (N = 10,945; 21,140 tumours combined). Includes 45 SHA-256-verified frozen input snapshots (cBioPortal v7.2.3 / DB v3.1.0, GDC mature miRNA-seq, RCSB PDB / AlphaFold v6 structures, ESM-2 3B / ESM-1v / ESM-IF1 3D / AlphaMissense saturation scores across all 213,940 single-amino-acid variants, CPTAC MS proteomics across 1,039 tumours, Broad DepMap 24Q4 CRISPRChronos across 1,150 cell lines, gnomAD v4 constraint, GTEx v10 54 healthy tissues, Human Protein Atlas, Open Targets, NCBI ClinVar [16,569 records; missense ROC-AUC = 0.9784], TCGA-CDR survival, and Thorsson PanImmune/HRD profiles), 26 derived tables, 10 technical validation audit tables, zero-dependency Python/CLI/unittest pipelines, R figure scripts, and an interactive static web explorer. Data CC BY 4.0; code MIT.

notes: Version 2.0.0 provides 45 SHA-256-verified frozen snapshots, 152,925 sample-level multi-modal rows, 6,292 functionally/structurally/ClinVar-annotated TCGA somatic mutations, 213,940-variant 3D + PLM saturation mutagenesis atlas, mature miRNA 5p:3p arm-usage profiles (n = 9,409), CPTAC proteomics (n = 1,039), DepMap CRISPR synthetic-lethality profiles (n = 1,150), GTEx v10 54-tissue baselines, MSK-IMPACT replication (N = 10,945), multivariable Cox survival benchmarks, zero-dependency CLI variant triage (scripts/query_variant.py), automated unit tests, and an interactive web explorer (docs/index.html).
